entityDescription:
IdeaCorp s. r. o. is a Slovak software engineering company established in 2013, specialising in systems for regulated and safety-critical operations — software that carries the burden of proof: who did what, under which authorisation, according to which revision of which document, and how that is demonstrated to a regulator on demand.
Ground-segment software and mission-control technologies. Telemetry acquisition and processing pipelines, append-only archives with deterministic full replay, and digital-twin integration. A single telemetry contract carries live, recorded and simulated sources, so the operational display does not distinguish between them.
Evidence-grade state handling. Event sourcing and CQRS with independent hash-chained audit trails, canonical serialisation, idempotency and compensating actions, risk-classified operations requiring recorded human approval, and data classification enforced as a routing constraint.
Simulation-first engineering. The company builds digital twins ahead of hardware and follows a simulation-first approach: software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop and batch modes; Monte Carlo campaigns with dispersion analysis feeding formal safety gates; every run recorded with its seed, model versions and inputs, so results are reproducible.
Applied cryptography for constrained links. A written wire specification with reference test vectors, implemented as protocol and client libraries: hybrid post-quantum key establishment (ML-KEM-768 with X25519) and ML-DSA-65 signatures in a canonical CBOR/COSE envelope, protecting payloads end to end independently of transport, with enforced crypto agility.
Platform. The company develops Aether, a modular software ecosystem built on a contract-first architecture, comprising over a dozen interoperable services in continuous internal operation. Aether integrates distributed AI orchestration with deterministic workflows and evidence-grade audit: AI-invoked capabilities are risk-classified, carry full provenance, and critical actions require recorded human approval. It provides the shared foundations — identity, audit, capability contracts, orchestration and telemetry — on which mission software, digital twins and AI-assisted decision support are built. Dedicated research programmes address unmanned aviation and the space ground segment.
Twelve consecutive profitable years, production systems in continuous business-critical use, and wholly owned and controlled by an EU natural person.
We are seeking opportunities to contribute to ESA programmes related to ground software, mission operations, AI-assisted autonomy, digital twins, telemetry processing and secure data infrastructures, as a partner or subcontractor on well-defined work packages.

Mitterberger:Lab is an independent digital product and innovation studio based in Austria, operating under the legal entity Claus Nisslmüller e.U. The company specializes in the design and development of human-centered digital systems, with a strong focus on data-intensive environments, decision-support interfaces, and AI-enabled applications.
The core mission of Mitterberger:Lab is to transform complex technical systems and datasets into clear, usable, and efficient digital solutions. By combining structured analysis with user-centered design methodologies, the company enables organizations to improve decision-making, system transparency, and operational performance.
Mitterberger:Lab operates at the intersection of User Experience (UX), Human-Machine Interface (HMI) design, data analytics, and frontend engineering. The studio develops scalable digital interfaces that allow users to interact effectively with complex information systems, particularly in contexts where clarity, reliability, and performance are critical.
Core competencies include:
Design and implementation of data-driven user interfaces and dashboards 
Development of decision-support systems and analytical tools 
UX optimization for complex technical and research platforms 
Integration of AI-supported insights into user workflows 
Development of scalable frontend architectures and design systems 
The company follows a structured and system-oriented approach, combining problem analysis, iterative prototyping, and validation with a strong alignment between technical feasibility and user requirements. Emphasis is placed on clarity, efficiency, and long-term sustainability of digital solutions.
Mitterberger:Lab’s expertise is particularly relevant for applications involving complex data interpretation and interaction, including Earth Observation data platforms, monitoring and control systems, research environments, and advanced analytics interfaces.
Through its interdisciplinary approach, Mitterberger:Lab acts as a specialized partner for organizations seeking to enhance the usability and effectiveness of their digital systems, ensuring that advanced technologies can be fully leveraged through intuitive and well-structured user interaction.

The core thematic areas of Green Goals include:
• climate change mitigation and adaptation
• air quality assessment, micrometeorology and environmental monitoring
• sustainable development and alignment with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
• ESG strategies and sustainability reporting
• energy
• circular economy approaches
• European projects
• innovation and entrepreneurship

Furthermore, she was consultant to the Municipality of Ioannina, as member of the Climate Transition Team, working on the Climate City Contract of the Municipality in the context of the EU Mission of Climate Neutral Cities.
This background enables the company to contribute to advanced climate and environmental monitoring, data interpretation and evidence-based decision support.

Uranium Supply:

We maintain a policy of diversification of flexibility sources, supply security, and demanding pricing
In ENUSA, we manage theenriched uranium supplyto the electric companies that own the Spanish nuclear power plants. 
We carry out the procurement of supplies with major global suppliers and maintain contracts withmain global suppliersof uranium concentrates, conversion services, and enrichment services.
Our portfolio of suppliers allows us to maintain apolicy of diversificationof sources of flexibility, security of supply and very demanding prices.
In addition to the purchase, we carry out thelogistics managementde los movimientos de uranio que se tienen que producir hasta la obtención del producto final: el uranio enriquecido.
Enusa guarantees supply to its customers, managing uranium stocks in several countries in order to provide service and security in this phase of the nuclear fuel cycle.

Design and Engineering
We have the latest technological advances through transfer agreements with our partners and licensors Westinghouse and General Electric (GE).This allows us to cover the design, manufacture and supply of fuel to domestic and foreign nuclear power plants, as well as all engineering services related to the management and optimisation of fuel use in the reactor.
The fuel engineering developed at ENUSA covers all technical aspects of the nuclear fuel lifetime: from conceptual development and introduction of new products for irradiation in commercial PWR and BWR reactors, to storage and transport in dry casks as irradiated fuel.
Thanks to our experience, we cover nuclear design aspects and radiological, mechanical, thermo-mechanical, thermo-hydraulic calculations of materials.
These activities are made possible because of the high qualification of ENUSA personnel and the use of calculation tools developed in-house and/or by our licensors Westinghouse and GE.
This knowledge and experience of fuel, its design and behaviour, as well as the integrated view of the whole life of nuclear fuel allow us to provide our customers with a unique set of high added-value services. They also allow us, either autonomously or in collaboration with technology partners, to develop new nuclear fuel fabrication and inspection equipment.
In ENUSA, engineering is supported by powerful R&D&I, cooperating with Spanish universities through collaboration projects or participation in training activities, and in the promotion of and/or participation in national and international projects on key technical aspects of fuel.
Manufacturing

We manufacture for Spanish and European nuclear power plants, integrating the most innovative technology and the latest advances on the market.
The fuel assemblies are manufactured in our factory in Juzbado (Salamanca).
The activity focuses on the collection of uranium and the components necessary for the process, engineering and the manufacture of fuel assemblies for Spanish and European nuclear power plants, integrating the most innovative technology and the latest advances on the market.

GRDprocess Sàrl is a Swiss research and technology company focused on the design, prototyping and experimental validation of artificial-intelligence architectures and autonomous systems. Originally active in information systems, process analysis and data-based decision support, the company refocused its primary activity in late 2025 on research and development in embodied and distributed intelligence.

Its main programme, Darwin Zero, develops an end-to-end architecture for autonomous units whose internal structures and behaviour improve through their own operation. The architecture couples bounded internal regulation, action, movement, local sensing, distributed prediction, error feedback and persistent reconfiguration within one continuous and traceable process.

GRDprocess develops the associated controlled digital environments, explicit body and sensor geometries, distributed processing layers, causal logging, replayable configurations, observer dashboards, and functional and causal-ablation tests. Current work is focused on demonstrating persistent adaptation under changing and partially unknown conditions, before progressively transferring the validated architecture to physical robotic units and connected multi-unit systems.

GRDprocess is seeking collaboration with research institutes, robotics companies, space-sector organisations and technology partners in embodied AI, autonomous exploration, resilient robotics, sensorimotor systems, distributed intelligence, simulation, hardware integration and experimental validation.

In parallel, GRDprocess develops THE FRAME, a structural-analysis methodology for decomposing and testing the coherence of normative and technical rules.

entityDescription:
Rosswag GmbH is mainly known under the name Edelstahl Rosswag for over 100 years of experience in dealing with metal materials. Founded in 1911, the family-run company with more than 200 employees is one of the world's leading suppliers of open-die forged products weighing up to 4.5 tons, which are manufactured in-house in a holistic process chain. The in-depth know-how in the manufacturing and testing processes is reflected in the high quality of the end products, which are used under heavy loads, for example in the aerospace industry or in energy engineering. With more than 30 employees in the area of ​​quality assurance alone, individual process flow plans are defined in order to be able to meet the specific requirements for mechanical-technological component properties. In addition, after the forging process, the heat treatment or the CNC machining, the products are examined for their quality-relevant properties in the own testing and materials laboratory.
Founded in 2014, Rosswag Engineering is expanding the product portfolio with engineering services and innovative manufacturing processes. The incorporation of the additive manufacturing process Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) enables the production of functionally optimized metallic components in addition to the forging operation. The know-how accumulated over decades in the field of materials science and materials technology, in conjunction with the holistic, company-internal process chain, serves as the basis for establishing and expanding the future business. In 2017, the globally unique process chain was expanded to include in-house metal powder production for the qualification of new materials. As a result, over 35 materials have now been qualified for additive manufacturing. Since 2018, Rosswag has a cooperation with the software developer ANSYS regarding process simulation for demanding manufacturing and qualification projects. Rosswag was the first company to be certified by TÜV SÜD both for the production of metal powders and for the serial production of functional components in the field of additive manufacturing. Rosswag's research-intensive innovation strategy has been honored with numerous awards in recent years.
